titleTr: Uzun bir sabah: had been + V-ing

explainTr: Geçmişteki bir andan önce başlayıp o ana kadar süren eylemi anlatır: had been + V-ing. Genellikle for (süre) ve since (başlangıç) ile gelir: She had been waiting for an hour when the bus came.

İkinci kullanımı sebep göstermektir: Her eyes were red because she had been crying. Burada eylemin kendisi (süreç) önemlidir. Past perfect ise sonucu ya da sayıyı vurgular: She had finished three worksheets.
Durum fiilleri (know, like, have, want) continuous yapılmaz: I had known him for years (had been knowing değil). Soru: How long had she been working? Olumsuz: She hadn't been sleeping well.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'Bir saattir bekliyordu' cümlesi tek bir yapıdır. İngilizcede geçmişteki bir anı da vermen gerekir: She had been waiting for an hour when I arrived (Ben geldiğimde bir saattir bekliyordu).

reading.title: A very long morning
reading.text:
By eleven o'clock, Hafsa felt as if she had been working for an entire day. Her alarm had gone off at 5:00 a.m., and she had been preparing ever since. At 5:30 Mr. Brown had called and asked her to cover a sixth-grade class at Jefferson Middle School because the regular teacher had a family emergency. Hafsa had never been to that school, so she had been searching the map on her phone for ten minutes before she finally found the right entrance.

When she arrived, the front office was crowded. A woman had been talking to the secretary for so long that Hafsa had to wait twenty minutes for her badge. By the time she reached Room 22, the students had been waiting in the hallway for almost fifteen minutes, and a few of them had been pushing each other. "Good morning," Hafsa said, trying to sound calm. "Please come in and find your seats."

Then she discovered that the sub plan asked her to hand out a worksheet, but the copier was jammed. She had been pressing buttons for ten minutes when a young teacher named Mr. Alvarez came by. "I have been fighting with this machine all year," he laughed, and he fixed it in seconds. Hafsa thanked him, and he added, "Come to my room at lunch. I have been saving some coffee for you."

Around ten thirty, the class had finally settled into silent reading. Hafsa sat down for the first time since she had left home. Her feet hurt, her throat was dry, and her tea had gone cold. A girl in the front row looked at her and whispered, "Ms. Hafsa, you look tired." Hafsa smiled. "I have been running since five o'clock," she said, "but I am fine."

Later she realized that the hardest part had not been the copier or the crowded office. It had been the fear of failing. Once the children started reading, that fear had quietly disappeared.

writing.promptTr: Uzun ve yorucu geçen bir sabahı anlat. Neden yorgun olduğunu açıklarken en az üç yerde had been + V-ing kullan.
writing.promptEn: Write a paragraph (120-180 words) about a long, tiring morning. Explain why you felt that way, using the past perfect continuous.
frames: By ten o'clock, I had been ... for ... hours.
I was tired because I had been ...
When ..., I had already been ... for ...
writing.model: Yesterday morning felt endless. By ten o'clock, I had been working for five hours, and I was completely exhausted. I had been getting ready since six, because Mr. Brown had asked me to arrive early. When I reached the school, the students had been waiting in the hallway for a long time, and they were quite noisy. I had been trying to stay calm, but my voice was getting weaker. I was also frustrated because the copier had been jamming all morning, so I had to write the worksheet on the whiteboard. My feet hurt because I had been standing without a break. Finally, at lunchtime, a friendly teacher gave me a cup of coffee. I had never been so grateful for a small thing. After lunch, everything was easier, and I realized that I could cope with a difficult day.
checklistTr: En az üç yerde had been + V-ing var mı?
For veya since ile süre ya da başlangıç belirttin mi?
Know, like, have gibi durum fiillerini continuous yapmadın mı?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?
